definitions.explanation: A person who is part of an organization, group, or body. A formal term emphasizing the person's role as a component of a larger whole.

examples.japanese: {委員会|いいんかい}の{構成員|こうせいいん}は{十名|じゅうめい}だ。
examples.english: The committee consists of ten members.

examples.japanese: {構成員|こうせいいん}の{全員|ぜんいん}が{会議|かいぎ}に{出席|しゅっせき}した。
{国際|こくさい}チームの{構成員|こうせいいん}は{様々|さまざま}な{国籍|こくせき}の{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}で{構成|こうせい}されている。
examples.english: The members of the international team are made up of researchers of various nationalities.

notes:
FORMATION: {構成|こうせい} (composition, formation) + {員|いん} (member, personnel).

USAGE: {構成員|こうせいいん} is a formal term used in official, legal, and organizational contexts. In everyday speech, メンバー or {会員|かいいん} is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {組織|そしき}の{構成員|こうせいいん}: members of an organization
- {構成員|こうせいいん}{全員|ぜんいん}: all members
- {構成員|こうせいいん}の{資格|しかく}: membership qualifications

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {構成員|こうせいいん}: formal term emphasizing being part of a structure
- メンバー: member (casual loanword)
- {会員|かいいん}: member of a club or association
- {社員|しゃいん}: company employee/member
